purpose: Define a minimal, strict-mode RAG layer for ai-slop-gate so that an LLM (or developer) can understand the context and implement it safely.

primary: Use Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground LLM decisions in the actual repository contents (code, manifests, docs).
Reduce hallucinations by forcing the model to rely on retrieved context and strict output formats.
Keep RAG as an internal detail of the LLM provider, without leaking complexity into the engine or policy layer.
non_goals: No separate microservice for RAG; everything stays in-process.
No full-text search engine integration at this stage (e.g. Elasticsearch, Opensearch).
No fine-tuning or training of models; only retrieval + prompting.
No automatic code modifications or auto-fix functionality.

high_level_concept.description: The LLM provider is extended with a RAG layer that retrieves the most relevant code and documentation chunks for a given analysis (e.g. PR diff, k8s manifests) and injects them into the prompt. The engine and policy remain unaware of RAG internals and treat the provider as a black box.
data_flow: Engine passes an analysis request to the LLM provider (e.g. diff + active rules).
LLM provider builds a retrieval query (based on diff, file paths, rule description).
Codebase index retrieves top-k relevant chunks from the repository index.
LLM provider constructs a strict prompt: instructions + retrieved context + user input + strict output contract.
Model generates a response, which is validated against expected format and constraints.
Engine consumes the validated response as usual (Decision, observations, etc.).

codebase_index.role: Maintain a vector index of repository content (code, manifests, docs) and provide semantic retrieval.
constraints: Stateless from the perspective of policy; only offers `index` and `query` primitives.
Does not call any LLM directly.
Does not implement policy or enforcement logic.

operations.build_index: Scan configured paths, chunk files, generate embeddings, persist index.
operations.update_index: Rebuild or incrementally update index when repository changes (can be tied to git SHA later).
operations.query: Given a text query, return top_k most relevant chunks with metadata (file path, line range, score).

chunking.role: Split files into manageable pieces with overlap to preserve local context.
rules: Preserve file path and approximate line ranges for each chunk.
Avoid splitting inside extremely small blocks if possible (e.g. keep function definitions intact when reasonable).

embeddings.role: Convert text chunks and queries into vectors for similarity search.
options: Remote embedding API from the same vendor as the LLM (if available).
constraints: Embedding choice and settings should be configured, not hardcoded.
Deterministic behavior for the same input (idempotent).

retrieval.role: Given a query, find most relevant chunks to serve as context.
behavior: Prefer fewer, highly relevant chunks over many noisy ones.
Always return chunk metadata (path, line range) alongside the text.

llm_provider_rag.role: A wrapper around the base LLM provider that adds retrieval and strict prompting.
responsibilities: Construct retrieval queries using diff, rule description, and optional extra hints from policy.
Call codebase_index.query() and collect top_k chunks.
Assemble a strict prompt with clear instructions and delimited context sections.
Apply strict sampling parameters to reduce hallucinations.
Validate model output against a schema/contract; reject or flag invalid responses.
constraints: Does not embed business logic of policy decisions (that stays in the engine).
Does not silently ignore validation errors; must surface them to the engine.

minimal_policy_snippet_example.description: This JSON fragment shows how a policy (or global config) can enable RAG and configure its parameters.

strict_mode_behavior.intent: Ensure that the model outputs only well-structured, grounded responses and reduce hallucinations.
mechanisms: Explicit instruction to only use provided CONTEXT and DIFF, not external knowledge.
JSON-only outputs with a predefined schema (e.g. decision, reasons, references to files/lines).
Validation step that parses JSON, checks required fields, and rejects malformed responses.
Optional self-check: re-run the same prompt and compare critical fields for stability.

fields.summary: short text summary of the analysis
fields.findings: list of issues or notes, each with severity, message, file, line_range
fields.references: list of context chunks used (file path + line range)

phase_1.name: Index and retrieval scaffolding
steps: Implement basic chunking with `chunk_size_chars` and `overlap_chars` and metadata (path, line range).
Integrate an embedding backend (local or remote) and define a stable embedding interface.
Implement a simple index store (in-memory or SQLite + similarity search).

phase_2.name: RAG-enabled LLM provider
steps: Create `llm_rag_provider` that wraps the base LLM provider.
Define a strict prompt template with sections: ROLE, POLICY_RULE, CONTEXT, INPUT (DIFF), OUTPUT_CONTRACT.
Wire retrieval: for each analysis request, build a query from rule + diff, call `codebase_index.query()`, and inject results into CONTEXT.
Apply strict sampling parameters from policy (temperature, top_p, max_tokens).
Implement JSON validation against `RagAnalysisResult` (or similar) and propagate validation errors.

phase_3.name: Engine integration and safety
steps: Allow policy/config to enable or disable RAG globally and/or per rule.
Update engine to choose between base LLM provider and RAG-enabled provider based on config.
Add tests that lock contracts: same input + same index state => same retrieval + stable structured output.
Add tests to ensure that invalid JSON or missing fields cause controlled failures, not silent acceptance.

key_entities_and_terms.Chunk: A piece of file content with associated metadata (file path, start/end line or char positions).
key_entities_and_terms.Embedding: Numeric vector representation of text used for similarity search.
key_entities_and_terms.Index: Data structure storing embeddings and metadata, allowing nearest-neighbor queries.
key_entities_and_terms.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: augmenting LLM prompts with retrieved, relevant context.
key_entities_and_terms.Strict mode: Configuration where sampling is conservative and outputs must follow a strict schema.
key_entities_and_terms.RagAnalysisResult: Canonical structured output type for RAG-based analyses in ai-slop-gate.
